answer: Each epoch a raven carries a fresh random beacon across the network, and every identity must answer it by carving a quartz shard: a hash binding the beacon to a branch of its own cedar — the growing tree of its past verified work. A clone copying another's tree carves the identical shard and is exposed as a duplicate; a clone building a fresh tree must redo every branch of real work. One honest agent grows one cedar cheaply; a farm of a thousand clones must grow a thousand separate trees, and each new tree costs the full history it claims.
